sources.excerpt: Blackstar LT-DIST - Pedal Manual | ManualsLib Sign In Download Table of Contents Contents Add to my manuals Delete from my manuals Share URL of this page: HTML Link: Blackstar LT-DIST - Pedal Manual '> Print this page × Bookmark added × Added to my manuals Manuals Brands Blackstar Manuals Music Pedal LT-DIST User manual Introduction Features Controls Technical Specification Important safety information References Download manual In Other Languages Blackstar LT-DIST - Pedal Manual Contents 1 Introduction 2 Features 3 Controls 4 Technical Specification 5 Important safety information 6 References 7 Download manual 8 In Other Languages Introduction Like all our products this pedal is the result of countless hours of painstaking Research and Development by our world-class design team. Based in Northampton (UK), the Blackstar team are all experienced musicians themselves and the sole aim of the development process is to provide guitarists with products which are the ultimate tools for self-expression. All Blackstar products are subjected to extensive laboratory and road testing to ensure that they are truly uncompromising in terms of reliability, quality and above all TONE. If you like what you hear and want to find out more about the Blackstar range of products please visit our website at www.blackstaramps.com . Features The LT DIST features Blackstar's patented ISF (Infinite Shape Feature) circuit, giving you infinite adjustment over the characteristics of the tone control and taking you from the USA to the UK and anywhere in between. Now you can effectively design your own tone and finally find 'the sound in your head'. Controls Gain The Gain control adjusts the amount of overdrive or distortion that the pedal will deliver. At low settings, counter clockwise (CCW), the LT DIST will deliver a clean boost, which in conjunction with the Level control can be used to overdrive an already distorting valve amplifier. As the Gain control is increased clockwise (CW) the sound will become more overdriven moving through crunch tones until, at its maximum position, a full distorted lead tone is arrived at. Level The Level control sets the overall level or volume from the LT DIST. It should be used in conjunction with the Gain control to achieve the exact type of drive you require. Generally speaking, to achieve the correct balance, at lower Gain settings the Level will be increased and at higher Gain settings the Level should be decreased. Tone The Tone control allows exact adjustment of the treble frequencies within the sound. At low settings, counter clockwise (CCW), the sound will be warm and darker in character. As the control is increased clockwise (CW) the sound will become brighter. At the maximum settings the tone will be aggressive and cutting. ISF The ISF control works in conjunction with the Tone control. It allows you to choose the exact tone signature you prefer. Fully CCW is a more American characteristic with a tight bottom end and more aggressive middle, and fully CW is a British characteristic which is more 'woody' and less aggressive. See illustration below. We recommend that to start with the ISF is set to half way and the Tone control set to taste. Then try gradually adjusting the ISF CW and CCW until you find the sound you prefer. Effect On/Off Switch Press this switch to turn the effect on or off. Effect On/Off LED When the LED is on the pedal is on. When the LED is not on the pedal is off. Input Plug your guitar in here. Always use a good quality screened guitar lead. To maximise battery life unplug your cable from the pedal when not in use. Output This output is for connection to the input of your amplifier or into other pedals or effects. For best noise performance we recommend you place the LT DIST pedal first in the effects chain. Always use a good quality screened guitar lead. DC Inlet For the input of a 9V DC adapter. Always use a Blackstar approved 9V adapter. Battery Compartment Insert a 9V PP3 batt
